note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 6.2 ("An implementation that accepts a Hold Time MUST use the negotiated value for the Hold Time."). Positive: TestRFC4271NegotiatedHoldTimeDrivesTimers verifies negotiateWith(local 90s, peer 30s) sets both neg.HoldTime=30 and s.timers.HoldTime()=30s. Negative: TestRFC4271LocalHoldTimeNotUsedWhenPeerProposesSmaller asserts local 90s is not installed when peer proposes 30s and that an out-of-range 1s/2s negotiation is floored to 3s rather than used verbatim.
